title: [WIP] Add view type switcher for list display
body:
- [x] Analyze the issue: sidebar navigation items reference named views (e.g., `viewName: 'pipeline'`) but the runtime doesn't serve `listViews` on objects, causing views to always fall back to grid/list
- [x] Add `views` with `listViews` to CRM config for opportunity (pipeline kanban), event (calendar), and project_task (board, gantt, timeline)
- [x] Merge stack-level views into objects in `objectstack.shared.ts` so the MSW-served metadata includes `listViews`
- [x] Fix console ObjectView to read `listViews` (camelCase per @objectstack/spec) with `list_views` fallback
- [x] Fix ViewDesignerPage to read `listViews` with `list_views` fallback
- [x] Verify build passes (42/42 tasks successful)
- [x] Verify all console tests pass (34 files, 273 tests)
- [x] Run code review and address feedback
- [x] Run CodeQL security check (0 alerts)
